Sentence (English): Early on in our marriage my wife and I had an entry level Bosch (still alot of $ for us! )
Comments (English): [ Great choice ] || ---------------- || Early on in our marriage my wife and I had an entry level Bosch (still alot of $ for us! ) and loved it. You had to learn *how* Bosch dishwashers dry with the German voodoo and all, but we found if you spend 10 minutes and read the manual then it works amazingly well. This 800 was a splurge, but since I do 90% of the dishes, I kind of went down the dishwasher rabbit hole for a week and ended up with this 800. Costco installation was great and took less than an hour. Came on time too! As for the dishwasher itself, you have to pay attention for the red LED shining on the floor to know it's running, because we cannot hear it running unless we bend down and put an ear right next to the front. No matter where you put the 800, noise won't be an issue. It cleans and dries super well. Even plastics. Just follow the instructions and get used to the dry settings. With no exposed heater element you can put plastics anywhere - even the bottom rack. The big test was a huge Pyrex casserole dish with baked and burnt on crap all the way around it. Didn't rinse it. I put it face down on the bottom rack to see if the claims were true. It cleaned it perfectly. Not a burnt speck or anything was left. We have never had a DW that could do THAT before. Anyhow, it's a great unit. Our first one lasted years and we sold it with our first starter house. We have a big family and cook virtually every meal. The 800 does great and we can't recommend it enough. We ended up removing the utensil basket to have more bottom rack room and put all utensils on the top (3rd) rack. Everything has come out clean and dry. More than we wanted to spend, but haven't regretted it.

Sentence (English): My husband developed a wrist condition, so we bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I'm glad I installed it. ] || ---------------- || My husband developed a wrist condition, so we bought a dishwasher. After using it for a couple of months, I've found that this product truly improves our quality of life. It not only protects my wrists, but also reduces conflicts over dividing household chores. Tetris is a bit difficult, but it's great because it washes most dishes, pots, and pans. It even washes cups really well. However, delicate dishes can chip, so consider using a dishwasher when purchasing. The only downside is that you have to clean the drain and keep the door open to prevent moisture buildup. Those who are quick with their hands and don't stress about washing dishes might not need it, as the dishwasher itself requires maintenance. However, for families with babies, large families, or those with wrist problems, it's a must-have. I also recommend the hot air dryer. I haven't tried the steam washer yet, as it takes well over two hours to clean.

You only had to connect the water supply. The Bosch manual had easy to follow diagrams with QR codes for videos. It's too bad Bosch has such a flimsy panel that no doubt would dent easily. In summary the machines are are very similar once installed and similar in price. Both are easy to operate. If you're having it installed then the KitchenAid installation challenges won't matter. The panel is nice and solid. We wouldn't have purchased the Bosch first but we didn't realize how flimsy the panel due to the store model was already being dented and you couldn't test it easily.

I live quite close to two cities so I can't understand why Whirlpool does not have more contracts with repair companies nearby. It will be much faster for us to either pay out of pocket for another appliance repair company (which Whirlpool says they will not reimburse) or to order the part and attempt to repair ourselves. Meanwhile, I have received 3 letters about signing up for an extended warranty. I will NOT be giving Whirlpool more money NOR trusting that their warranty is of any use whatsoever. What a worthless appliance and company. Also, as someone else noted, the racks began to rust some time ago.

Sentence (English): Until now, I had a positive view on the quality and reliability of GE appliances, supported by the near 20 year old This dishwasher clearly demonstrates that quality has gone down the drain in exchange for the company's maximization of profits.
Comments (English): [ Overpriced pile of garbage, GE going downhill. ] || ---------------- || Until now, I had a positive view on the quality and reliability of GE appliances, supported by the near 20 year old This dishwasher clearly demonstrates that quality has gone down the drain in exchange for the company's maximization of profits. While the unit looks fancy on the outside and boasts a list of exciting features, it is clear from unboxing to install that it is flimsy and cheaply built. Upon delivery, I had the Lowe's delivery guys wait while I unboxed to inspect for damage. All looked good so I sent them on their way. But then I noticed that the door did not close and latch easily. It met resistance and would tend to pop open if not forcefully latched. I figured the DW just needed to be installed and fastened to the cabinets and maybe given a little break in. So I proceed with install. Mounting to the cabinets and properly leveling didn't make it any better. I give it the benefit of the doubt and finish the install. First test run it leaks from the bottom corner of the door and I have to place a bowl underneath to catch the water - nearly a cup leaked throughout the normal wash cycle. Items in the upper and 3rd rack come out with food debris as if they haven't been be washed at all. Move them down to the middle and lower racks and run a heavy cycle and some items still come out with residue and even more leakage. (Mind you I made sure to toggle both the upper and lower zones for the wash). Upon closer examination I determined that the whole dishwasher frame is bent and racked and a couple rivets fastening the door gasket track have popped. So while the initial inspection at delivery didn't show obvious damage, it's clear now that the construction is substandard and easily damaged and may not show as large dents, scratches etc. Having read though all the disappointing reviews, I now see the common thread - the materials and build quality are poor and a high percentage of units are damaged and doomed right from the get go. If you're lucky enough to get one not damaged, I wouldn't have high hopes for it to last more than a couple years. Far cry from the 20 year old GE dishwasher I uninstalled for this new one. Comparing them side by side it's clear how much more solid everything is on the old unit. Our throw away society is disgusting. Buying a Bosch instead for not much more and hopeful it'll live up to it's reputation, and that they haven't gone downhill like GE.

Upon delivery, I had the Lowe's delivery guys wait while I unboxed to inspect for damage. All looked good so I sent them on their way. But then I noticed that the door did not close and latch easily. It met resistance and would tend to pop open if not forcefully latched. I figured the DW just needed to be installed and fastened to the cabinets and maybe given a little break in. So I proceed with install. Mounting to the cabinets and properly leveling didn't make it any better. I give it the benefit of the doubt and finish the install. First test run it leaks from the bottom corner of the door and I have to place a bowl underneath to catch the water - nearly a cup leaked throughout the normal wash cycle. Items in the upper and 3rd rack come out with food debris as if they haven't been be washed at all. Move them down to the middle and lower racks and run a heavy cycle and some items still come out with residue and even more leakage. (Mind you I made sure to toggle both the upper and lower zones for the wash). Upon closer examination I determined that the whole dishwasher frame is bent and racked and a couple rivets fastening the door gasket track have popped. So while the initial inspection at delivery didn't show obvious damage, it's clear now that the construction is substandard and easily damaged and may not show as large dents, scratches etc. Having read though all the disappointing reviews, I now see the common thread - the materials and build quality are poor and a high percentage of units are damaged and doomed right from the get go. If you're lucky enough to get one not damaged, I wouldn't have high hopes for it to last more than a couple years. Far cry from the 20 year old GE dishwasher I uninstalled for this new one. Comparing them side by side it's clear how much more solid everything is on the old unit. Our throw away society is disgusting. Buying a Bosch instead for not much more and hopeful it'll live up to it's reputation, and that they haven't gone downhill like GE.

Also a couple of the tines on the racks have already started to bend (not impressed with that) so we are hoping that tines breaking off is not going to be an issue. It also takes 3 hrs to run the "normal" cycle. add sani rinse and pro dry and increase that time. I am on the fence with whether I would buy another kitchenaid product. Time will tell.

One installed and turned on, I couldn't tell if it was working it was so quiet.As far as installation goes, very straightforward. Without the leverage each of the plastic legs started to gum up and strip a little.Overall, I'm very happy with the machine. It's quiet, works great and has a little try at the top for little things that have traditionally been hard to put in DW's.

Sentence (English): The Bosch 500 Series dishwasher is a fantastic appliance.
Comments (English): [ Looks great, performs even better ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 500 Series dishwasher is a fantastic appliance. It was my first time installing a dishwasher and all in with removal of the old unit and it took under two hours to complete. I had to use the junction box adapter but this was no more difficult than wiring a light fixture. Installation is straight forward and Bosch provides a QR code in the instruction manual that links you to a video which was helpful. Since installing, I have been very impressed with the cleaning power of this dishwasher. I barely rinse any loose food and the dishes come out looking spotless. The unit is very quiet when running and has a cool red light feature that lights up on the floor to indicate the dishwasher is still in use. Since the dishwasher does not contain a heating element for drying you can safely place items on any rack. This model comes standard with three racks and the middle slides up and down to provide versatility and allows you to adjust based on the items you are loading. It also comes with a cutlery rack which is a little on the smaller side but has still worked for my needs. As a previously mentioned this dishwasher does not heat up to dry like more conventional dishwashers. It does however contain the Bosch AutoAir feature which automatically opens the dishwasher after the cycle and allows your dishes to complete trying. I've noticed without using this setting the dishes are still a little wet upon completion but the AutoAir function does work very well and helps eliminate the extra moisture. Overall, I've been very impressed by the performance of this dishwasher and the sleek design.

Sentence (English): I have now owned two Bosch dishwashers and I am so pleased by everything about them!
Comments (English): [ The best dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I have now owned two Bosch dishwashers and I am so pleased by everything about them! On the outside, they have a sleek minimalist design with clean modern lines. On the inside, the racks are thoughtfully designed for efficiency and functionality, with several of the holders able to fold down as needed to make space for larger items. But by far the most valuable characteristic of the Bosch is that it operates quietly and discreetly. I love the fact that I can start the dishwasher and no one will even know that it is working unless you notice the red light indicator. I can enjoy conversation with my family, listen to music, stream a video, without having all the noise of the dishwasher interrupting things. For all that it is quiet, the Bosch dishwasher gets my dishes very clean, even if they are oddly shaped. It is by far the best dishwasher I have ever owned! I am also very appreciative and thankful for the Bosch customer service, which has been helpful in providing all the information I require to keep my machine in top shape. Because of the outstanding quality and service, I am definitely considering purchasing an entire suite of Bosch products for my next home. I would like to see how their engineering expertise is applied to ovens and cooktops.

Sentence (English): This is the first time I got a GE product and definitely not the last time.
Comments (English): [ One word: Amazing product. ] || ---------------- || This is the first time I got a GE product and definitely not the last time. I absolutely love this dishwasher. Installation was quick/easy. The fingerprint resistant feature is definitely true. The look of the dishwasher is very elegant. The buttons on top are easy to understand. The 3 rack system is new to me and I absolutely love it. Big spoons are too big to fit on top if you lay them sideways. Also, I put a spoon on the top rack that had dried up oatmeal on it and it didn't fully come off. I highly recommend putting silverware in the designated basket which has jets underneath which is on the bottom. My silverware is always so clean and shiny! I love the jets in the middle rack for cups. I have ran this dishwasher a few times already since installation and will say that I can fit a lot of dishes in it. The middle rack height can be adjusted which is great. Another amazing feature in this dishwasher is the use of the SMART HQ system via an app. It was easy to install, easy to follow and use. You can change settings on the dishwasher and start it/stop it/delay it through your phone. When the cycle finishes, it lets you know on the app! It sounds silly but as a mother of two busy toddlers it is a very helpful feature. One thing I am not sure about and need to research a little is how often does the rinse aid solution need to get refilled. I don't see a mark or any place where I see it getting emptier (maybe the SMART HQ will let me know). I am so in love with this dishwasher and I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): ### Delivery.
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): It cleaned up so well.
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ My quality of life has improved thanks to the Sangju dishwasher aunt! ] || ---------------- || ### Delivery. Two days after ordering, the installer came to set up the dishwasher before installation. The installer removed the drawer under the sink and made a neat spot for the dishwasher! We had a bit of space, so we had to add an extra plate, which cost an additional 30,000 won! After 2-3 hours of sweaty work, the installer completed the perfect space! He even installed a divider to divide the empty space with flair. ### Installation. Installation was done the next morning. Having carefully planned the space in advance, the installation was a breeze. ### User Review. We previously used a 6-person dishwasher, but with only 5 people in our family, it was too small. We couldn't fit any pots or pans. We ended up just using bowls and cups. The pots and pans also had to be washed twice, which was a hassle. Then, after installing the 14-person dishwasher, it was heaven. If only the dishwasher lady had worked part-time before. It feels like it's a permanent fixture in my home now! It even takes a large pot, frying pan, and kimchi container, as well as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, a spatula, a ladle, spoons, and chopsticks. It's so convenient and nice to be able to put everything in the dishwasher. On weekends, I just rinse the food scraps after breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and put them in the dishwasher. I run it in the evening and wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning! It's so quiet that you can't even tell if it's running at night! The cleaning power is second to none! It has three stages, with large washing wings at the bottom, in the middle, and on top, so it thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny. It washes thoroughly, and the automatic door-opening function after each wash ensures proper moisture removal even without a separate drying function! The cheese caked on my soup bowl in the microwave was completely removed, and the pan I cooked pork belly in was completely grease-free. It cleaned up so well. I thought it would cost more in electricity and detergent than a six-person dishwasher, but it's still perfect. I can do three or more loads of dishes for six people at once. The electricity bill and detergent usage will probably be similar! I used to wonder why I needed a dishwasher that took an hour to wash. Now that I've used it, I understand why everyone says it improves their quality of life. My husband and I used to fight a lot about who should do the dishes. Since getting this dishwasher, peace has returned to our home. I can use multiple cups, and the cups don't smell like water, which is so great! If you have space for two dishwashers, definitely buy the bigger one. Bigger is best. I think I understand why people say bigger is better when it comes to appliances. I used to use a six-person dishwasher, but now I use a 14-person dishwasher. If you have more than two people, I recommend the larger size! The white color makes it look almost invisible. It blends in well with other kitchen appliances, and it's so easy to use. I heard it can be connected to your smartphone. It's so convenient that I can use it all the time! Hehe. I hope this helps you with your purchase. ^^ This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Our 10-year-old Kitchenaid dishwasher finally gave out, so we decided to give Bosch a try.
Comments (English): Our 10-year-old Kitchenaid dishwasher finally gave out, so we decided to give Bosch a try. After a month of use, I wish we had gone with Kitchenaid again. Pros: . -Pretty quiet. I like the red light that shines on the floor to let you know the dishwasher is still running. -The top rack is very spacious and easy to load and unload. -The racks are easy to pull out and roll smoothly. -It has a clean and modern aesthetic (too bad ours came with a smudge on the door). Cons:. -Right out of the box, there was a large smudge on the left side of the door that we haven't been able to clean off. -After running a cycle, our dishes are always wet even when we use the "Air" function, which automatically opens the door after the cycle ends. -The buttons on the top panel feel very cheap and some of them aren't centered properly. -For this price point, there should be more wash and dry options. -After a month of use, there is still a heavy chemical smell every time we open the door. We even ran a couple cleaning cycles with dishwasher cleaner tablets. -The utensil baskets are lightweight and not very secure. We often have to rehang them after unloading.

Sentence (English): We were excited to buy this dishwasher along with the matching stove, fridge, and microwave.
Comments (English): [ Only last 2.5 years before multiple issues ] || ---------------- || We were excited to buy this dishwasher along with the matching stove, fridge, and microwave. It's beautiful to look at it. For the first 2.5 years, the dishwasher was super quiet, cleaned dishes well, no problem. Then it all went downhill. We bought the extended warranty - haven't seen any benefit yet. We've been waiting for a month now to have it fixed. First heating element, then control panel. Broke down again the next day. The service department said we maybe got a faulty control panel, so they ordered another one. The technician came to the house to install it, looked at the dishwasher and said you don't need another control panel. He called the warranty place - they said to order a new motor instead. We've been waiting over a week, still no new motor. We're starting to feel like this will never be fixed. How long do we have to go through this before the dishwasher is replaced? Error codes blink and pause (you must count them) instead of number codes – not a good system. It seems to be a guessing game with service. If the dishwasher is not fixed nor replaced, we have lost additional money paying for an extended warranty for nothing. We may have to cut our losses and buy a new machine, but then of course it won't match. Another piece of advice, buy a large dish rack that KitchenAid makes - at least they did a good job with that - pricey but worth it. Helps when doing dishes for 2 hours every single day. And oh beware of "Aqualift Self Clean" ovens in the matching KitchenAid oven. It is terrible - doesn't clean at all. Spent 3 days cleaning the oven with elbow grease.

Sentence (English): This model is exclusive to Lowes and apparently does not come with the insulation blanket.
Comments (English): [ Loud and Smelly ] || ---------------- || This model is exclusive to Lowes and apparently does not come with the insulation blanket. It is VERY loud, definitely NOT 48 dBA. My old dishwasher was 48 and this one is MUCH louder. My decibel reader is registering it at 59 dBA. I will be contacting Bosch to see if they can remedy this problem. Additionally, be aware that Bosch ships their dishwasher with some water in the tub. Apparently at the factory they test the machine for leaks and some water is left inside. Well, it's summer and the first delivery that arrived was moldy and stunk like a disgusting dirty rag. I called Bosch thinking this was some kind of a mistake but they confirmed that some water is normal, apologized for the mold, and said someone would get back to me. No one did, so I called Lowes and asked for an exchange. The second delivery didn't even make it into the house because the delivery guys showed me that the door was bent. Ok, that happens sometimes. The third delivery was today, I inspected it to make sure that it was in good shape. It was on the outside, but the inside had some water which smelled bad. Not as bad as the first machine that was delivered but not pleasant at all. There was also some black stuff (mold? gunk? grease? ) on the tines. See photo as an example of what's all over the racks. I accepted the delivery because we can't wait any longer for another machine. The installation was fine. We're running it now hoping to get rid of the smell, but it's as loud as the cheap builder-grade dishwasher that I had 20 years ago where I couldn't watch tv while it was running.

Once it was time to replace it, I turned to KitchenAid since I've been happy with my double oven and fancy cooktop. As expected, my new dishwasher hasn't disappointed. It's extremely quiet. At first, we couldn't tell if it was washing or not. It's that quiet! So far, our dishes and silverware come out clean, but we're still exploring the various features. Regarding the install, I hired a local service. I'm grateful that I read another customer's warning to purchase the Whirlpool dishwasher install kit since the KitchenAid dishwashers don't come with all of the parts. That made my install so smooth. I would buy another KitchenAid dishwasher, but I expect this one to last for years.

Sentence (English): I had experience using a dishwasher before, so I bought it as a built-in when I moved.
Comments (English): [ I had experience using a dishwasher before, so while moving . ] || ---------------- || I had experience using a dishwasher before, so I bought it as a built-in when I moved. I had to remodel the chest of drawers for 12 people, so I ordered it for 8 people, and two days later, the reformer contacted me and remodeled it the next day. I thought there was no reform fee for the standard size, but they said that if it didn't fit the size of the dishwasher, it would have to be reformed, so I reformed it for 90,000 won. I came to install the dishwasher the next day, but I had work, so I opened the door and started working. After a few minutes, I received a text message and checked. The basic drain is free, but I can install other drainage facilities in the future. When I came home and checked the drain, I felt that the drain was not connected when the water purifier was installed. Install drains as standard.
Comments (Original): [ 전에 식세기를 사용해본 경험이 있어서  이사하면서 ... ] || ---------------- || 전에 식세기를 사용해본 경험이 있어서  이사하면서 빌트인으로 구매하게 되었습니다. 12인용은 서랍장을 리폼해야되서 8인용으로 주문하고 이틀 뒤에 리폼기사님 연락오셔서 다음날 리폼 했어요. 규격장은 리폼비 없는줄 알았는데 식세기 크기에 안맞으면 리폼해야 된다고해서 9만원에 리폼했습니다. 다음날 식기세척기 설치 하러 오셨는데 일이 있어서 문만열어드리고 작업시작함. 몇분있다 문자가오서 확인하니 기본 배수구는 무료인데 앞으로 다른배수시설을 설치 할수있이니 3구로 설치어떻냐고 하길래 그렇게 해달라고 하고 3만원 설치비 나옴. 집에와서 배수구 확인해보니 정수기 설치시 배수구 연결을 안하더라고요ㅜㅜ 당했다는 기분이듬. 배수구는 기본으로 설치 하세요.

Sentence (English): When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand.
Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. Since my sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, she doesn't wash the dishes right away, but collects them and does them all at once. I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang. Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. Sentence (English): I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang.
Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. Since my sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, she doesn't wash the dishes right away, but collects them and does them all at once. I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang. Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Sentence (English): The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. Since my sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, she doesn't wash the dishes right away, but collects them and does them all at once. I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang. Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand.
