Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. Since my sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, she doesn't wash the dishes right away, but collects them and does them all at once. I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang. Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Comments (English): [ Washing dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || When I saw my sister using a dishwasher, I was jealous of her because she thought it was a waste of money to use a dishwasher instead of just washing a few dishes by hand. Since my sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, she doesn't wash the dishes right away, but collects them and does them all at once. I got a good opportunity to use a dishwasher from Coupang. Since I got it anyway, I bought a special detergent and used it right away. Since I have a family of four, after eating, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and sometimes a soup bowl. - The difference from a regular dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the water container that comes with it about 3 times when you start, so it's not very inconvenient. = Wash with 72-degree hot water. I poured cold water, but it quickly heated up to 72-degree hot water and washed the dishes. It seems to remove grease when washing the dishes with hot water. - The media dishwasher has a transparent window, so it's easy to wash the dishes. You can see it all. You can see that a strong stream of water is sprayed from above and below to clean every corner. I checked to see if it was done well and wow, it came out really clean and neat. The downside of the media dishwasher is that you have to pour water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only have to pour it when you turn it on for the first time - When the water is full, it automatically sounds an alarm. There is no chance of water overflowing. There is a water tank, so it's easy to pour water and there's no spilling. Unlike large dishwashers, you don't have to collect them all at once. You can wash the dishes right away after eating. - It has wheels that make it easy to put dishes in and take them out of the dishwasher. - It has five functions: standard, strong, eco, and quick steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes, so you can have a cup of coffee and feel more relaxed and happy. It would be even better for a house with a baby. It's so convenient and good for washing milk bottles. It's a recommended product for the media dishwasher that has few space restrictions, washes dishes right away, and doesn't mess up the interior. Sentence (English): I learned about LG Electronics’ home subscription service when I was purchasing a variety of home appliances for my new home.
Comments (English): I learned about LG Electronics’ home subscription service when I was purchasing a variety of home appliances for my new home. While receiving advice at a store, they recommended a subscription service, and I became more interested because they said I could pay for the subscription fee with the points I accumulated while purchasing. It also helped reduce the initial cost burden. There were many products, but the dishwasher was the one I started subscribing to. It was a product I really needed, but I was hesitant because of the price range, so I was really happy that there was a subscription option. The biggest advantage was that I could use it for a reasonable monthly fee. What I especially liked was the service that automatically delivered the necessary parts when they were replaced. I’m someone who misses things like this, so it was really convenient that they managed it on time. It was really nice that they automatically delivered it to me even when I forgot. Also, since I was planning to move in the near future, the fact that they offered pre-installation service was really attractive. If I had just bought it, I would have called a separate installer and spent money, which would have been stressful, but since I was subscribing, I could naturally receive care for this as well. I also liked that the A/S period was extended during the subscription period. Since I can receive after-sales service for a longer period of time than with regular purchase products, I felt more secure because I thought I could leave it without worrying if it broke down. It was a really big advantage to be able to use products I use every day for a longer period of time and reliably. I started with a dishwasher, but now I’m thinking about switching to subscriptions for other home appliances like stylers and air conditioners. #CareService. #HomeApplianceSubscription
Comments (Original): LG전자 가정구독 서비스를 알게 된 건, 신혼집 가전제품을 다품목 구매할 때였어요. 매장에서 상담을 받다가 구독 서비스라는게 있다고 추천을 받았고, 마침 구매하면서 적립되는 포인트로도 구독 요금 결제가 가능하다고 해서 더 관심이 생겼어요. 초기 비용 부담도 덜 수 있기도 했구요.여러 제품들이 있었지만 그중에서 구독을 시작한 건 식기세척기였어요. 꼭 필요한 제품이었지만 가격대가 있어서 망설이던 차에, 구독이라는 선택지가 있어서 너무 좋았어요. 매달 부담 없는 금액으로 이용할 수 있다는 점이 제일 큰 장점이었고요.특히 좋았던 건, 필요한 부품을 알아서 교체 시기에 맞춰 배송해주는 서비스 였어요. 저는 이런 걸 놓치는 사람이라서, 때에 맞추어 관리해준다는 점이 정말 편했어요. 잊고 있어도 알아서 택배배송 해줘서 정말 좋았어요.또 가까운 시일내에 이사계획이 있는 저한테는 설치·이전 서비스가 가능하다는 점도 너무 매력적이었어요. 그냥 샀다면 따로 설치 기사 부르고 돈 들고 스트레스였을 텐데, 구독 중이니까 이 부분도 자연스럽게 케어받을 수 있었어요.구독하는 기간동안 A/S 기간이 함께 길어진다는 점도 좋았어요. 일반 구매 제품보다 더 오랫동안 사후 관리를 받을 수 있으니까, 혹시 고장이 나더라도 걱정 없이 맡길 수 있겠다는 생각에 더 든든했어요. 매일 사용할 제품을 더 오래, 안정적으로 사용할 수 있다는 게 정말 큰 장점이었어요. 식기세척기로 시작했지만, 지금은 스타일러나 에어컨 같은 다른 가전도 구독으로 바꿔볼까 고민 중이에요.#케어서비스#가전구독

First, delivery and installation are crucial, so let me explain. Just like with other Rocket Installation products, you can specify a delivery date. Once you specify a delivery date, a Samsung partner will visit you the day before, inspecting your kitchen and making simple cabinet work to secure space for the dishwasher. They say a pre-delivery visit is essential to ensure your kitchen is ready for installation before delivering the dishwasher! It'd be disappointing to carry a heavy load and then not be able to install it, right? After a simple cabinet work, Samsung will come and install it on the delivery date you specified. This is a crucial point! You'll most likely need a power strip. Be sure to bring one! Depending on your kitchen setup, you may need to make additional small holes. I chose one that fits perfectly under the sink! The built-in dishwasher went in perfectly. ^^ The color isn't a weird pink at all. It's a subtle indie pink. The installation took about 40 minutes, including a few extras. Two people from Samsung came and installed it in a jiffy. They even kindly explained how to use it before leaving. The product itself, including its features and quality, is truly beyond words. First of all, I trust Samsung! The functions are intuitive and have only the essentials. I imagined a life where I'd just eat all day, run the dishwasher at night, and it would be ready in the morning. But when I see people using dishwashers, they say that if they use a six-person dishwasher, they'll have no room even for dishes after a big meal. But this one is designed for 14 people, so it holds a ton of dishes. I can even fit all the dishes from the day in it! I use the solid tablet-type Frosh detergent. If I fill the dishwasher full and run it, it puts in one tablet. If I fill it halfway and run it, it puts in half a tablet, so it's just the right amount. There's also a function that partially rotates only the top layer, excluding the bottom layer. So you don't have to fill the entire dishwasher! You can run it on the course you want among various courses, and when the course is finished, the door opens slightly to let out hot air. It even dries naturally. When you wake up in the morning, all the dishes are done. All you have to do is put the food in and eat it. ^^ How convenient! The cleaning power is also powerful. I didn't realize it when I didn't have it, but after using it, I don't think I can go back to my life without a dishwasher. I now understand why everyone praises it as a third-generation aunt. Comments (English): [ How could I have lived without a dishwasher? The majesty of my great-aunt! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is the king of the three. I've always felt the need for a dishwasher, but when I actually thought about buying one, I kept putting it off because my kitchen space seemed inadequate. But my wrists were hurting, and I was finally thinking, "I really need to get one," so I finally got the chance to install a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher! First, delivery and installation are crucial, so let me explain. Just like with other Rocket Installation products, you can specify a delivery date. Once you specify a delivery date, a Samsung partner will visit you the day before, inspecting your kitchen and making simple cabinet work to secure space for the dishwasher. They say a pre-delivery visit is essential to ensure your kitchen is ready for installation before delivering the dishwasher! It'd be disappointing to carry a heavy load and then not be able to install it, right? After a simple cabinet work, Samsung will come and install it on the delivery date you specified. This is a crucial point! You'll most likely need a power strip. Be sure to bring one! Depending on your kitchen setup, you may need to make additional small holes. I chose one that fits perfectly under the sink! The built-in dishwasher went in perfectly. ^^ The color isn't a weird pink at all. It's a subtle indie pink. The installation took about 40 minutes, including a few extras. Two people from Samsung came and installed it in a jiffy. They even kindly explained how to use it before leaving. The product itself, including its features and quality, is truly beyond words. First of all, I trust Samsung! The functions are intuitive and have only the essentials. I imagined a life where I'd just eat all day, run the dishwasher at night, and it would be ready in the morning. But when I see people using dishwashers, they say that if they use a six-person dishwasher, they'll have no room even for dishes after a big meal. But this one is designed for 14 people, so it holds a ton of dishes. I can even fit all the dishes from the day in it! I use the solid tablet-type Frosh detergent. If I fill the dishwasher full and run it, it puts in one tablet. If I fill it halfway and run it, it puts in half a tablet, so it's just the right amount. There's also a function that partially rotates only the top layer, excluding the bottom layer. So you don't have to fill the entire dishwasher! You can run it on the course you want among various courses, and when the course is finished, the door opens slightly to let out hot air. It even dries naturally. When you wake up in the morning, all the dishes are done. All you have to do is put the food in and eat it. ^^ How convenient! The cleaning power is also powerful. I didn't realize it when I didn't have it, but after using it, I don't think I can go back to my life without a dishwasher. I now understand why everyone praises it as a third-generation aunt. I'm so, so satisfied! For those of you who came here searching for a dishwasher, worrying will only prolong the time you have to suffer with your wrists, so hurry and get it! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I've always felt the need for a dishwasher, but when I actually thought about buying one, I kept putting it off because my kitchen space seemed inadequate. First, delivery and installation are crucial, so let me explain. Just like with other Rocket Installation products, you can specify a delivery date. Once you specify a delivery date, a Samsung partner will visit you the day before, inspecting your kitchen and making simple cabinet work to secure space for the dishwasher. They say a pre-delivery visit is essential to ensure your kitchen is ready for installation before delivering the dishwasher! It'd be disappointing to carry a heavy load and then not be able to install it, right? After a simple cabinet work, Samsung will come and install it on the delivery date you specified. This is a crucial point! You'll most likely need a power strip. Be sure to bring one! Depending on your kitchen setup, you may need to make additional small holes. I chose one that fits perfectly under the sink! The built-in dishwasher went in perfectly. ^^ The color isn't a weird pink at all. It's a subtle indie pink. The installation took about 40 minutes, including a few extras. Two people from Samsung came and installed it in a jiffy. They even kindly explained how to use it before leaving. The product itself, including its features and quality, is truly beyond words. First of all, I trust Samsung! The functions are intuitive and have only the essentials. I imagined a life where I'd just eat all day, run the dishwasher at night, and it would be ready in the morning. But when I see people using dishwashers, they say that if they use a six-person dishwasher, they'll have no room even for dishes after a big meal. But this one is designed for 14 people, so it holds a ton of dishes. I can even fit all the dishes from the day in it! I use the solid tablet-type Frosh detergent. If I fill the dishwasher full and run it, it puts in one tablet. If I fill it halfway and run it, it puts in half a tablet, so it's just the right amount. There's also a function that partially rotates only the top layer, excluding the bottom layer. So you don't have to fill the entire dishwasher! You can run it on the course you want among various courses, and when the course is finished, the door opens slightly to let out hot air. It even dries naturally. When you wake up in the morning, all the dishes are done. All you have to do is put the food in and eat it. ^^ How convenient! The cleaning power is also powerful. I didn't realize it when I didn't have it, but after using it, I don't think I can go back to my life without a dishwasher. I now understand why everyone praises it as a third-generation aunt. I'm so, so satisfied! For those of you who came here searching for a dishwasher, worrying will only prolong the time you have to suffer with your wrists, so hurry and get it! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I've always felt the need for a dishwasher, but when I actually thought about buying one, I kept putting it off because my kitchen space seemed inadequate. The product itself, including its features and quality, is truly beyond words. First of all, I trust Samsung! The functions are intuitive and have only the essentials. I imagined a life where I'd just eat all day, run the dishwasher at night, and it would be ready in the morning. But when I see people using dishwashers, they say that if they use a six-person dishwasher, they'll have no room even for dishes after a big meal. But this one is designed for 14 people, so it holds a ton of dishes. I can even fit all the dishes from the day in it! I use the solid tablet-type Frosh detergent. There's also a function that partially rotates only the top layer, excluding the bottom layer. So you don't have to fill the entire dishwasher! You can run it on the course you want among various courses, and when the course is finished, the door opens slightly to let out hot air. It even dries naturally. When you wake up in the morning, all the dishes are done. All you have to do is put the food in and eat it. ^^ How convenient! The cleaning power is also powerful. I didn't realize it when I didn't have it, but after using it, I don't think I can go back to my life without a dishwasher. I now understand why everyone praises it as a third-generation aunt. I'm so, so satisfied! For those of you who came here searching for a dishwasher, worrying will only prolong the time you have to suffer with your wrists, so hurry and get it! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that changes the kitchen atmosphere ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit 14-seat built-in dishwasher in Glamp Pink. It has ample capacity for 14 people. The night cycle is quiet, and it washes directly with high-temperature water. No need to worry about plastic deformation. One dishwasher can transform your kitchen atmosphere. The day before the dishwasher installation, a technician called and scheduled a visit. They removed the drawers under the sink and rebuilt the lower cabinets to fit the dishwasher. Two installers arrived the next day and completed the installation. The lower cabinets took a little over two hours, and the dishwasher installation took about thirty minutes. Please note that you may need a power strip depending on your kitchen's electrical system! The built-in unit is beautiful in Glamp Pink. The subtle pink color is sophisticated, not tacky, and really enlivens the kitchen. It gives the kitchen a fresh, modern feel. Because it seats 14 people, it's perfect for a four-person household. One meal can be quite a lot of dishes. The dishwasher is spacious enough to fit everything. The top and middle racks move up and down, making it convenient to adjust according to the type of dish. Since it uses high-temperature direct water, it doesn't warp the plastic, so I also included plastic containers. It also has a night cycle function, so even if you have to run the dishwasher late at night, there's no need to worry about noise. In addition to the night cycle, you can also customize it with other settings like a heavy duty cycle, steam soak, high-temperature sterilization, heavy drying, and additional rinse. For greasy dishes, I use the heavy duty cycle, high-temperature sterilization, and additional rinse for a cleaner finish. Another advantage is that you can replace the panel after a few years. If you want to change the look of your kitchen, just buy a new panel. I use solid detergent. When I have a small load, I use half a solid detergent. When I have a large load, I use one solid detergent. It washes everything cleanly! I have the Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher in Glamping Pink. Sentence (English): This is a review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher (14-place setting), in Glam Pink.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher that changes the kitchen atmosphere ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher (14-place setting), in Glam Pink. It has a generous 14-place capacity. The night cycle keeps the noise low. It features high-temperature direct water washing, so there is no need to worry about plastic deformation. Just one dishwasher can change the atmosphere of the kitchen. The technician called to schedule an appointment the day before the installation. They removed the lower sink drawers and renovated the base cabinets to fit the dishwasher size. The next day, two technicians came and completed the installation. The base cabinet renovation took a little over two hours, while the dishwasher installation took about thirty minutes. Please note that you may need a power strip depending on your kitchen's electrical situation! It is a built-in type in Glam Pink, and it is so pretty. It is not tacky but a luxurious, subtle pink color that really brings the kitchen atmosphere to life. It feels like the interior has been completely renovated. Since it is a 14-place setting, it is perfect for a family of four. We generate a lot of dishes for a single meal, but the dishwasher's interior is quite spacious, so everything fits inside. Since the top and middle racks move up and down, it is convenient to adjust according to the type of dishes. Because it uses high-temperature direct water, there is no plastic deformation, so I put plastic containers in as well. Thanks to the night cycle function, I don't have to worry about noise even if I need to run the dishwasher late at night. In addition to the night cycle, I can customize settings as I like, such as the powerful cycle, steam soak, high-temperature sterilization, powerful drying, and extra rinses. When washing greasy dishes, running it with the powerful cycle, high-temperature sterilization, and extra rinses results in a clean finish. Another advantage is that the panel can be replaced after a few years. If I want to change the atmosphere of my kitchen while using it, I can simply purchase a new panel. I use solid detergent. When there are few dishes, I use about half a container of solid detergent, and when there are many, I use a whole container, which cleans them perfectly! I chose the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher in Glam Pink. I love the capacity, features, and design! You know how tiring it is to do the dishes and get back and knee pain. It seems like installing a dishwasher is a must-have at my parents' house these days. If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful" at the bottom.
